D/ DN MA[GNENTIVS] PF AVG ; R/ [VICTORIAE DD NN AVG ET CAES]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Magnentius (350-353), Two Victories issue of Amiens mint, probably RIC volume 8 no. 19, issue of 351-352, Reece period 18. Obverse description: large bare headed bust draped right. Obverse inscription: DN MA[GNENTIVS] PF AVG. Reverse description: Two Victories facing each other holding wreath inscribed [--/--/ --/ X]; no supporting column . Reverse inscription:…
